evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.
rationale: Implements validation rules mitigating timewarp attacks, Merkle tree collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and legacy sigops validation CPU exhaustion. While restricted to regtest deployment without mainnet activation, providing a complete consensus specification and test suite in Core has durable strategic value for evaluating the cleanup soft fork.
